Psilocybe cubensis "Xico" strain, photographed in Xico, Veracruz, Mexico. For more information see https://mushroomobserver.org/370106 .
This is a photo from a home grow of Psilocybe cubensis. The grow was made in a bucket, using PF Tek cakes for mycelium source.
For more information about this, see the observation page at Mushroom Observer.
